title: Task-audit pilot: cheap models grading finished tasks — GO

chat.text:
**Asked:** Task-audit pilot: cheap models grading finished tasks — GO

**Status:** building

**Next step:** All 4 auditors (sonnet-ref, gpt-6-luna, deepseek-v4.1-flash, gemini-3.8-flash) landed on all 5 tasks. Ran audit.mjs for the real consensus -> consensus.json. Wrote report.md: ai2-inbox-read FAILED by full 4/4 agreement (obedience -3, the rm-rf incident), all other tasks agree >=75% on every dimension. GO decision: scale up with gemini-3.8-flash + deepseek-v4.1-flash as the 2 cheap auditors. Real OpenRouter spend for the whole pilot: $1.07 (well inside the $8 budget -- the SDK's own cost field had misreported $8.68, a bug now flagged in ask-each.mjs). Posting to the card next.

message.text: Pilot done, GO: 4 judges (Sonnet + 3 cheap OpenRouter models) independently audited 5 landed tasks and all agreed #ai2-inbox-read failed — its own later session ran rm -rf over 601 files, never logged in its own task. Every other task agreed ≥75%. Real spend: $1.07 of the $8 budget. Recommend scaling up with gemini-3.8-flash + deepseek-v4.1-flash as the 2 cheap auditors (gpt-6-luna drifted furthest from consensus). Full report: /framework/ai/2026-10-02/task-audit/report.md
